svg.text: Stay engaged until the gap passes A_Distance by a margin, not the instant it does
Two engaged lines and the footprint gap between them
The barrier holds engaged lines at
Gap over 10 s while two troops hold each other at the barrier
Each gap in the red bar was a moment the troop was 'free': its chain could pull it away, it stopped charging, its facing could turn.
Decision (SU-45): the hold applies to everything that reads 'engaged': charges, facing lock, Assault, ranged fire, chains.
EngagementHoldMargin (Formation Tuning) is 1.0. This answers Q-16 (engagement exit hysteresis).
